Bug_Title: MS: Field isn’t final and cannot be protected from malicious code (MS_CANNOT_BE_FINAL)
Bug_Details:
A mutable static field could be changed by malicious code or
       by accident from another package.
  Unfortunately, the way the field is used doesn't allow
  any easy fix to this problem.
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the generated code through the mutable static field'mutableStaticField'. This field is declared as public and not final, allowing it to be modified by any part of the program, including malicious code.
Trigger_Explanation: The generated JUnit test case triggers the bug by calling the `showBug` method which modifies the mutable static field `mutableStaticField`. The test cases then assert that the field retains its initial value, which will fail due to the modification made by `showBug`, thus demonstrating the bug.
